data.long_meaning: The name Prakesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prakasha' which means 'Lord of Creativity'. This name is believed to bring creativity, innovation, and a positive outlook towards life. Parents who choose Prakesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of creativity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
